payload.text: I read this as a read-only visual audit of the delete-worktree modal - inspect the screenshot, dialog implementation, theme tokens, and tests, then report concrete defects only.
Screenshot matches a light delete-worktree modal with a wrapped path and unknown divergence. Next I’ll read the dialog, theme tokens, and nearby dialog patterns.
The modal is light on a dark app; I’m checking tokens, sibling dialogs, and how `ahead`/`behind` get those question marks.
Theme tokens say dark cards should be charcoal, but the screenshot is white — I’m checking Tailwind mapping, mount site, and preview data next.
The white card only matches light tokens; I’m checking default appearance, original Ferryx dialog, and how this one is mounted.
The screenshot matches light-theme tokens plus a hard dark scrim. I’ll compare original Ferryx delete UI and how this dialog is mounted.
Original Ferryx already boxes long paths with `break-all`. I’ll check path helpers, overlay conventions, and null-divergence handling next.

I sampled the PNG and the dialog source. The white sheet is light-theme `bg-card`, not a missing token; the real bugs are the path wrap, the `?` divergence placeholder, and a hardcoded dark body behind the sheet. ## Screenshot vs source | Pixel | Value | Token it matches | |---|---|---| | Card fill | `#ffffff` | `--card` in `:root[data-theme="light"]` (`ui/src/settings-runtime.css`) | | Title text | `rgb(23,23,23)` | light `--foreground: #171717` | | Delete button | `rgb(185,29,29)` ≈ `#b91c1c` | light `--destructive` | | Button label | near-white, no dark pixels | light `--destructive-foreground: #fafafa` | | Stage around the sheet | `rgb(9,11,15)` | `body` `bg-[#09090b]` and/or a dark terminal under `bg-black/60` | Charcoal/dark cannot paint this pair. Those modes use `--card: #171717` / `#141414` and `--destructive: #ff6568` with **dark** label text (`ui/src/index.css`). The dialog is on light tokens. The dark ring is the scrim/body/terminal, not a second theme on the panel. `WorktreeDeleteDialog` already uses semantic surfaces (`bg-card`, `text-foreground`, `bg-destructive`). There is no `bg-white`. Do not restyle it to a forced dark sheet. ## Defects ### 1. Long path hyphen-wraps in the sentence ```131:134:ui/src/components/WorktreeDeleteDialog.tsx

Review the branch state before deleting {worktree.path}.

``` The screenshot breaks at the product hyphen: `.../orca-` / `lite/.orca-worktrees/...`. The span has no `break-all` / `break-words`. The browser wraps on `-`. `max-w-lg` + `p-4` + `text-xs` mono cannot hold `/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/.orca-worktrees/rorca-qa/e2e-qa` on one line, so some wrap is required. The bug is inlining it in a sentence so the wrap lands inside `orca-lite`. Same app already boxes long paths: ```135:137:ui/src/components/ProjectDialogs.tsx
{selectedPath}
``` Original Ferryx delete UI uses the same `break-all` + `bg-muted/35` list box. Smallest fix: keep a short sentence, move `worktree.path` into that boxed `break-all` block. Do not invent a new path-shortener. ### 2. `? ahead · ? behind` is a coded empty state, and it looks broken ```144:144:ui/src/components/WorktreeDeleteDialog.tsx ``` Screenshot: **Upstream: None** and **Divergence: ? ahead · ? behind**. Backend does this on purpose when there is no upstream: ```529:555:src-tauri/src/worktree/manager.rs let (ahead, behind) = if let Some(upstream_ref) = upstream.as_deref() { // rev-list --left-right --count (ahead, behind) } else { (None, None) }; ``` `?` is not used anywhere else as an empty state. The sibling cell already says `None`. Smallest fix in the dialog only (no Rust change): - `preview.upstream == null` → Divergence `None` (same word as Upstream) - else → `` `${ahead ?? "—"} ahead · ${behind ?? "—"} behind` `` Tests only cover `ahead: 2, behind: 1`. The null path is untested. ### 3. Light card on a dark stage (clash, not a `bg-card` miss) Two illegitimate dark layers sit behind a correctly light card: ```16:16:ui/index.html ``` That hex never follows `data-theme`. Workspace theme contract already bans one-off hex on the App shell (`ui/src/workspaceThemeContract.test.ts`) and misses this body class. ```113:118:ui/src/components/WorktreeDeleteDialog.tsx
`. jsdom cannot assert line breaks; the class is the machine check. Add Project is the oracle. 2. Preview `{ upstream: null, ahead: null, behind: null }` → `queryByText("? ahead · ? behind")` is null. Divergence is the existing sentinel `None` (query the Divergence row, not the Upstream row). 3. Keep the existing numeric case (`2 ahead` / `1 behind`). 4. If you lock the clash: dialog class includes `bg-card` and not `bg-white` / `bg-[#`; `ui/index.html` body has no `#09090b`. That proves: long paths wrap as a boxed path, missing upstream does not look like a failed bind, and the sheet stays on theme tokens instead of a fixed white fill.
